sha256_javascript: function sha256(s){let bytes=[];for(let c of s){let n=c.codePointAt(0);if(n<128)bytes.push(n);else if(n<2048)bytes.push(192|(n>>6),128|(n&63));else if(n<65536)bytes.push(224|(n>>12),128|(n>>6&63),128|(n&63));else bytes.push(240|(n>>18),128|(n>>12&63),128|(n>>6&63),128|(n&63))}let bit=bytes.length*8;bytes.push(128);while(bytes.length%64!==56)bytes.push(0);for(let i=7;i>=0;i--)bytes.push(Math.floor(bit/2**(8*i))&255);let H=[],K=[];for(let p=2;K.length<64;p++){let prime=true;for(let d=2;d*d<=p;d++)if(p%d===0){prime=false;break}if(prime){if(H.length<8)H.push((Math.sqrt(p)%1*2**32)>>>0);K.push((Math.cbrt(p)%1*2**32)>>>0)}}const rr=(x,n)=>(x>>>n)|(x<<(32-n));for(let off=0;off<bytes.length;off+=64){let w=[];for(let i=0;i<16;i++)w[i]=(bytes[off+4*i]<<24)|(bytes[off+4*i+1]<<16)|(bytes[off+4*i+2]<<8)|bytes[off+4*i+3];for(let i=16;i<64;i++){let x=w[i-15],y=w[i-2];w[i]=((rr(x,7)^rr(x,18)^(x>>>3))+w[i-16]+(rr(y,17)^rr(y,19)^(y>>>10))+w[i-7])|0}let [a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h]=H;for(let i=0;i<64;i++){let t=(h+(rr(e,6)^rr(e,11)^rr(e,25))+((e&f)^(~e&g))+K[i]+w[i])|0,u=((rr(a,2)^rr(a,13)^rr(a,22))+((a&b)^(a&c)^(b&c)))|0;[a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h]=[(t+u)|0,a,b,c,(d+t)|0,e,f,g]}H=H.map((x,i)=>(x+[a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h][i])>>>0)}return H.map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")).join("")}
